objective_value: <float> Total cost equal to the sum of opened operating-room fixed costs, surgeon-hospital-day fixed costs, and overtime costs, minus the rewards earned from scheduled optional patients.

assignments.surgeon_id: <int> Identifier of the surgeon assigned to perform this patient's surgery.
assignments.hospital_id: <int> Identifier of the hospital where this patient's surgery is performed.
assignments.day: <int> Day in the planning horizon on which this patient's surgery takes place.
assignments.or_id: <int> Identifier of the operating room within the chosen hospital used for this patient.
assignments.is_mandatory: <bool> Whether the scheduled patient is a mandatory case (true) or an optional case (false).
assignments.T_ps: <float> Total operating-room occupation time for this patient with the assigned surgeon, equal to preparation time plus surgeon-specific surgical procedure time plus cleaning time.
assignments.finish_time: <float> Clock time within the day at which the surgical procedure on this patient is completed.
assignments.surgery_start_time: <float> Clock time within the day at which the surgeon begins the surgical procedure on this patient.
assignments.room_entry_time: <float> Clock time within the day at which the patient enters the operating room and preparation begins.
assignments.room_exit_time: <float> Clock time within the day at which the patient leaves the operating room after cleaning is finished.

opened_ors.hospital_id: <int> Identifier of the hospital containing the opened operating room.
opened_ors.day: <int> Day in the planning horizon on which the operating room is opened.
opened_ors.or_id: <int> Identifier of the operating room that is opened in the given hospital on the given day.
opened_ors.regular_time: <int> Regular non-overtime session length available in this operating room on this day.
opened_ors.completion_time: <float> Clock time at which the last surgery in this operating room finishes, including its subsequent cleaning.
opened_ors.overtime: <float> Amount of overtime used in this operating room beyond its regular session length.

surgeon_assignments.surgeon_id: <int> Identifier of the surgeon deployed to a hospital on a given day.
surgeon_assignments.hospital_id: <int> Identifier of the hospital to which the surgeon is deployed on this day.
surgeon_assignments.day: <int> Day in the planning horizon on which the surgeon works at the assigned hospital.
surgeon_assignments.start_time: <float> Clock time at which the surgeon begins working at the assigned hospital on this day.
surgeon_assignments.end_time: <float> Clock time at which the surgeon finishes working at the assigned hospital on this day.

or_sequences.hospital_id: <int> Identifier of the hospital containing the operating room shared by the two patients.
or_sequences.day: <int> Day in the planning horizon on which both patients are scheduled in the same operating room.
or_sequences.or_id: <int> Identifier of the operating room in which both patients are scheduled on this day.
or_sequences.patient_p: <int> Identifier of the first patient in the ordered pair sharing this operating room on this day.
or_sequences.patient_k: <int> Identifier of the second patient in the ordered pair sharing this operating room on this day.
or_sequences.p_after_k: <int> Equals 1 if patient_p is operated on after patient_k in this operating room, and 0 if patient_k is operated on after patient_p.

surgeon_sequences.hospital_id: <int> Identifier of the hospital where the two patients share the same surgeon on the given day.
surgeon_sequences.day: <int> Day in the planning horizon on which the surgeon operates on both patients.
surgeon_sequences.surgeon_id: <int> Identifier of the surgeon who performs both patients' surgeries at this hospital on this day.
surgeon_sequences.patient_p: <int> Identifier of the first patient in the ordered pair sharing this surgeon on this day.
surgeon_sequences.patient_k: <int> Identifier of the second patient in the ordered pair sharing this surgeon on this day.
surgeon_sequences.p_after_k: <int> Equals 1 if patient_p's surgery is performed after patient_k's by this surgeon, and 0 if patient_k's surgery is performed after patient_p's.
